title: System
description: A RHEL system registered with Red Hat Insights for monitoring and recommendations.

system_uuid.description: The unique identifier of the system.

display_name.description: The display name of the system.

last_seen.description: The last time the system checked in with Insights.

stale_at.description: The date when the system will be considered stale.

hits.description: The number of active Advisor recommendations.

critical_hits.description: The number of critical severity recommendations.

important_hits.description: The number of important severity recommendations.

moderate_hits.description: The number of moderate severity recommendations.

low_hits.description: The number of low severity recommendations.

rhel_version.description: The RHEL version running on the system.
